augment.augmented.crafting.desc: Adds a portable crafting grid to the backpack
augment.augmented.crafting.select_to_cra: Select an item to craft from the grid below
augment.augmented.swapping.desc: Automatically swaps the held tool for one inside the backpack that matches the block being mined.
augment.augmented.experience.desc:
Stores up to 30 levels and returns it to the player after death.
Can store 60 levels when used with §dRecall§r.
augment.backpacked.experience.title: Stored EXP
augment.augmented.feeding.desc:
Auto feeds the player from the backpack.
Can be configured to prioritize feeding based on nutrition or saturation.
Only one priority can be selected.
augment.backpacked.feeding.mode.tooltip: The consumption mode determines what value is checked before consuming food
augment.backpacked.feeding.nutrition.too:
Prioritize Hunger as criteria to consume food. 

Food will only be consumed if hunger is less than the foods nutrition value.
augment.backpacked.feeding.saturation.to:
Prioritize Fullness as criteria to consume food. 

Food will only be consumed if fullness is less than the foods saturation value.
augment.augmented.recovery.desc: Creates a trail that leads to the players last death location
augment.augmented.trash.desc: Tosses unwanted items from selected inventory based on filter
augment.backpacked.trash.mode.tooltip: The inventory mode determines which inventory will drop selected items
augment.backpacked.trash.mode.backpack.t: Selected items will be dropped from backpack
augment.backpacked.trash.mode.player.too: Selected items will be dropped from player
augment.backpacked.trash.mode.both.toolt: Selected items will be dropped from both the backpack and player
